technical_and_design_decisions: Implement the coverage as black-box acceptance tests using the repository's existing acceptance-test framework, build conventions, and assertion libraries.
Exercise each processor or sink through its supported public configuration and runtime interface rather than testing private implementation details.
Use deterministic test fixtures and isolated temporary resources so the tests are repeatable in CI.
Mock or embed external integrations where practical: an in-memory or temporary filesystem for HDFS behavior and a local SMTP test server for mail behavior.
Cover the primary successful processing path and the most important validation or failure behavior for each module, while avoiding broad unit-test expansion outside the requested modules.
Register all acceptance tests in the existing CI test lifecycle so they execute on every CI build without requiring production external services.
assumptions: The repository, build, acceptance-test harness, and CI pipeline already exist and require extension rather than creation from scratch.
Existing examples and conventions for processor and sink acceptance tests are available for reuse.
The requested modules have stable public configuration and runtime APIs, and no production-code changes are required.
The script and scripts modules can share common fixtures and test infrastructure, with separate coverage for their distinct behavior.
CI agents provide the required Java 17-or-newer environment and can run the acceptance tests without manual intervention.
External HDFS and SMTP services are not available in CI; tests will use the project's supported embedded, mock, or containerized test facilities.
Effort includes implementation, local execution, troubleshooting, and review-ready test changes, but excludes substantial refactoring of the existing test framework or CI infrastructure.

activities.activity_description: Inspect module structure, existing acceptance tests, build profiles, test fixtures, CI configuration, and public configuration APIs; identify reusable patterns and define the coverage matrix.
Implement or adapt shared fixtures, input data, output assertions, temporary-resource handling, lifecycle setup, and any common utilities needed by the requested processor and sink tests.
Add acceptance scenarios for normal tuple-to-JSON processing, representative field and value combinations, output assertions, and relevant invalid-input or configuration behavior.

activities.activity_name: script and scripts processor acceptance coverage
activities.activity_description: Add acceptance scenarios for both script processors, including representative script execution, input/output propagation, configuration differences, and failure handling using deterministic script fixtures.
Add acceptance scenarios for splitting input into multiple outputs, preserving expected fields or metadata, handling representative delimiters or configuration, and validating edge behavior.
Add acceptance tests that send representative gauge records to the sink and verify the resulting metric state, labels, values, and relevant update behavior.
Add acceptance tests for aggregation and counter updates across multiple records, including grouping dimensions, accumulated values, and representative reset or boundary behavior.
Add acceptance tests for counting field values, including repeated values, distinct values, missing or invalid fields where applicable, and verification of emitted or stored counters.

Add acceptance tests for dataset creation and record persistence using an isolated embedded, mock, temporary, or containerized HDFS-compatible test facility, including path and file-content assertions.
Add acceptance tests using a local SMTP test server or equivalent fixture to verify recipient, subject, body, message formatting, and representative error handling.
Connect the new acceptance tests to the appropriate build lifecycle and CI job, configure required test resources and profiles, and ensure they run automatically on every CI build.

activities.activity_name: Full execution, troubleshooting, and regression verification
activities.activity_description: Run targeted and complete test suites, diagnose flaky or environment-sensitive behavior, correct test isolation and cleanup issues, and verify compatibility with existing tests.
Document test-resource requirements and execution conventions where needed, remove temporary code, standardize naming, and prepare the increment for review.
